annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Industry and Trade of the Czech Republic (Government of the Czech Republic)
key_provisions_or_claims: Creates an AI Committee under the Ministry of Industry and Trade to coordinate implementation, with annual progress reports.
Establishes a European Centre of Excellence in AI, a European Test Centre and Digital Innovation Hubs in Prague.
Plans analysis of liability for damage from autonomous and collaborative systems, including possible compulsory insurance.
Plans regulatory sandboxes, AI cybersecurity certification and standardisation, and an Expert Platform and Forum on legal and ethical rules.
Calls for retraining, tax and social system adjustments for automation, and an interdepartmental working group on autonomous vehicles.
annotation.summary_en: The Czech Republic's National AI Strategy (2019) sets seven priority areas: research, financing, industry, education, labour market, legal and ethical aspects, and international cooperation. It is mostly innovation-oriented, with limited embodied content: plans to review liability and insurance for autonomous systems, autonomous vehicle legislation, and safety assurances for robots and autonomous weapons.
